Dead.note: The player the Lleech kills that night.

Poisoned.note: The host the Lleech picks on the first night.
Poisoned.ambiguous: The wiki says any player and doesn't say whether the Lleech may pick itself.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: The host is chosen once, on the first night.

reminderPlaceholders.note: The host is poisoned; then the Lleech kills each night.

full.text: The Lleech chooses a player: mark them *POISONED*. They are the Lleech’s host.
full.reason: Says the Poisoned token marks the host for the whole game.
